items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: working with Dave [Grusin] on the St. Elsewhere theme

ctx.x: Name this tune: [scats “Theme from St. Elsewhere”]

Oh yes. St. Elsewhere, yeah working with Dave [Grusin] on the St. Elsewhere theme. That was — I had just started at GRP when that happened. And it was just all layered up with synthesizers. There was a long, long day and bringing in this outside synchronizer and this 3/4 inch pneumatic and linking it up to this deck. I mean it seemed all very Steampunk-Rube Goldberg compared to now, where you just would be doing it on Pro Tools and you would have an embedded video file and streamers and everything else that you…
Was there any acoustic instruments on that recording?
